title: Summoning of the Demonic Path Commander
next_chapter_hook: The Demonic Path Commander Declares He Will Personally Arrive at the Imperial Capital in Ten Days, the Countdown to the Destined Decisive Battle Begins

text.content: That eye that transcended causality slowly dissolved in the void, leaving only one final sentence echoing in Chen Ji's ear: 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao was merely a chess piece I left behind in those years. The true Chess Player never left that dimension you cannot imagine.' Chen Ji stood in the ruins, the surrounding broken walls and rubble cracked by the confrontation, as if even heaven and earth were witnessing this dialogue that should not exist between them. His fingers trembled slightly—not from fear, but from a long-unfelt excitement. Chess piece? Chess Player? What did this mean? The origins of the Tianji Record were far more unfathomable than he had imagined.

dialogue.content: 'Young Master, that gaze has already touched the depths of your soul.' Mo Xiansheng's aged voice came from the Jade Slip in his embrace, carrying a rare gravity. 'It spoke truly—the Tianji Record is indeed merely a chess piece... But the one playing the game has been waiting from the very beginning.'

text.content: As Chen Ji was about to respond, he suddenly felt a fierce burning sensation in his chest—the location where the Tianji Record Fragment resided. The burning spread like a tide, followed by a strange yet familiar aura emerging from the fragment, like a resonance deep within the bloodline. The sensation was inexplicable yet made his heartbeats involuntarily accelerate by threefold. Threads of destiny trembled in the invisible realm, as if something of the same origin and root was calling him through some indescribable means.

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, though it didn't reach his eyes. 'It seems my 'twin brother' is more impatient than I imagined.' He slowly closed his eyes, voluntarily following that thread of destiny's pull. In an instant, his divine sense traversed a thousand miles, passing through layers of clouds, crossing mountains and rivers,直达那片黑云压城的魔道大军深处。

text.content: In the darkness, a figure sat upon a throne of white bones, surrounded by demonic energy so dense it was almost tangible. His features bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, yet were far more fierce and sharp, like a demonic sword drawn from its sheath. Those eyes burned with the same Heavenly Secret power as Chen Ji's, yet displayed a completely opposite hue—where Chen Ji saw golden threads of causality, what surged in his gaze was a river of destiny as black as ink.

dialogue.content: 'I have waited for you for a long time, my other half.' The figure upon the throne spoke, his voice deep and resonant, like the toll of an ancient bell. 'When I was chosen by the Tianji Record to become its inheritor, you, in your worthless state, stole the Heavenly Fate that should have been mine. Now, it is time to set everything right.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt a boundless power attempting to establish a deeper connection with him—that was the unique resonance between twins of destiny, a bond that transcended space and time. He saw his counterpart's memories flash by like a carousel: the same origins, the same selection by the Tianji Record, yet due to a chance deviation, they walked utterly different paths. One was discarded by the sect like refuse, while the other rose to command a million-strong army in the Demonic Path.

dialogue.content: 'You and I were originally one—the Tianji Record separated us, and now that it is incomplete, neither of us can touch the true truth.' The Demonic Path Commander rose to his feet, the throne of white bones shattering behind him. 'Fuse with me, and we shall become a complete existence. Then, whether heaven's way or those lofty Chess Players—all shall tremble beneath our feet.'

choice.prompt: Facing the fusion invitation from the twin of destiny, what choice will Chen Ji make?

choices.description: Fuse with the twin, abandoning independent consciousness to become a complete twin of destiny. The price is losing self-uniqueness, but gaining the complete Heavenly Secret power.
choices.visible_cost: Lose independent personality and memory dominance
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete Tianji Record and all the power of the twin of destiny
choices.risk_hint: Once fused, one will no longer be 'Chen Ji'

text.content: Chen Ji felt the boundless power contained within that call. Fusion meant strength, meant completeness, meant never being alone again. His fingers trembled slightly, as if about to reach toward that vortex of destiny. Yet the moment his fingertips were about to touch it, he suddenly smiled—that was a kind of relief after seeing through everything.

dialogue.content: 'Fusion?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'You and I are both castoffs of the Tianji Record, manipulated like puppets by those Chess Players between their thighs. Do you think fusion can break the chess game? No, we will only become a larger chess piece.'

choices.description: Completely sever the resonance of destiny, declaring war from a hostile stance. Emphasize that one would rather be destroyed than fuse, walking an irreconcilable path of opposition.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent will, declare one's own path
choices.risk_hint: Will suffer the backlash from the severed resonance of destiny

text.content: Chen Ji violently opened his eyes, golden Heavenly Secret power erupting in his pupils. He was no one's appendage, nor would he become a chess piece for any existence. If destiny demanded he bow his head, he would instead defy heaven to change his fate! The two wills collided violently in the void, and Chen Ji felt as if ten thousand needles were piercing through his mind.

dialogue.content: 'You want war? Then fight.' Chen Ji's voice was like an ice blade. 'Though I, Chen Ji, am trash, I never pick up others' cold leftovers. You have your Demonic Path, I have my own road—who will emerge victorious, we'll see.'

choices.description: Neither merging nor opposing, but attempting to establish an equal cooperative relationship. Simultaneously preserving independent consciousness, exploring the third possibility of fate's twin-born coexisting.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of his trump cards in exchange for trust
choices.visible_reward: Gaining temporary support from the demonic army and intelligence advantage
choices.risk_hint: The other party may not necessarily accept an equal proposal

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond immediately; instead, he closed his eyes and carefully probed at the edge of fate's resonance. He knew that merging meant losing oneself, while opposing would only result in mutual destruction. But what if the third possibility could be found?

dialogue.content: 「You're right, we were originally one.」 Chen Ji's voice suddenly became peaceful, 「But being one doesn't necessarily mean merging. You and I walk our own paths, occasionally meeting at fate's intersection points, isn't that more interesting than forcibly becoming one?」

「The third possibility?」 A playful glint flickered in the demonic commander's eyes. 「Interesting, you're more intriguing than I imagined. But you should understand—the twin-born of fate cannot run parallel forever. One day, either you devour me or I devour you.」

「Then let that day come later.」 Chen Ji's voice transmitted through fate's resonance. 「How about you and I make a pact? Before the final showdown, we can share information and each take what we need. You want the world, I want... to live long enough to see the truth. When that day comes, we'll settle this destiny.」

text.content: The demonic commander fell silent for a moment, those pitch-black eyes churning with complex emotions. He was scrutinizing, judging, weighing the pros and cons of this proposal. After a long while, a low laugh escaped his throat, like a malevolent dragon murmuring from the abyss. 「Very well, I accept.」

dialogue.content: 「But I won't give you much time.」 The demonic commander's voice suddenly turned cold. 「In ten days, I will personally lead a million-strong demonic army to the imperial capital. Then, the three great sects will turn to ashes, and you... must make your final choice at that moment.」

text.content: Chen Ji felt that thread of fate's resonance slowly dissipating, the burning sensation from the Tianji Record Fragment in his chest gradually fading. He opened his eyes again, finding himself still standing in the ruins, as if that conversation spanning a thousand miles was merely an illusion. But he knew it was all real—his twin brother, commander of a hundred thousand demonic troops, Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: 「Young Master, you've made the right choice.」 Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded. 「Merging means being completely controlled by fate, opposing only leads to mutual destruction. Only by maintaining independence can you retain the possibility of turning the tables in chaotic times.」

choice.prompt: After reaching an agreement with the demonic commander, Chen Ji needed to decide his next course of action

choices.description: Use this buffer period to collect detailed intelligence on the demonic army and Ling Yuan. Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will win every battle.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence on the demonic army, unlock strategic map
choices.risk_hint: Investigation action may expose one's whereabouts

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, already calculating in his heart. Ten days—neither long nor short. He had to find out what trump cards Ling Yuan truly held, what the real combat strength of that million-strong demonic army was, and whether... there were other puppet masters behind that man.

choices.description: Proactively warn the three great sects, trading on an 'insider' identity for protection and resources, seeking maximum benefit in the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Expose some abilities to attract attention
choices.visible_reward: Gain resource support from the three great sects, enhance reputation in the martial world
choices.risk_hint: Risk being labeled as a demonic spy

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smirk. The three great sects, the Demonic Path army, and the so-called 'Chess Player'... The game grew larger and larger, and he was willing to be the most insignificant piece on the board. When everyone thought he was trash—that was the best time to create chaos.

choices.description: Utilizing the characteristics of the Tianji Record Fragment to accelerate cultivation, to face the coming destiny battle with absolute strength.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming massive Heavenly Fate and resources
choices.visible_reward: Breaking through current realm, significant Combat Power increase
choices.risk_hint: Possibly missing critical intelligence window period

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pushing down all distracting thoughts. Regardless of how the chess game changed, one's own strength was the foundation. If he could break through the current bottleneck in ten days, then even if Ling Yuan personally made a move, he would have the strength to fight. The Tianji Record slowly circulated within him, golden threads of karma appearing once more.

Just then, a faint sound echoed from the depths of the ruins. Chen Ji's brow furrowed, his divine sense instantly probing outward, only to discover the approaching person was no enemy—that familiar cold aura, that arrogant yet anxious spiritual fluctuation... Su Qingyao. That woman who had always tried to expose his true colors was now rushing toward him at extreme speed.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's figure burst from the shadows, her garments stained with several shocking bloodstains, clearly having gone through a bitter battle. Her gaze swept quickly over Chen Ji, and after confirming he was unharmed, the tension between her brows eased by only three-tenths, "It's good you're safe. The Demonic Path army has begun mobilizing, and the imperial capital is in imminent danger!"

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this woman who was clearly filled with suspicion toward him yet rushed to his aid without hesitation when he faced true danger. A subtle emotion stirred in his heart. This was Su Qingyao—cold on the surface but warm at heart, who should hate him to the bone yet couldn't let go of that inexplicable concern. He stepped forward, revealing the timid smile characteristic of atrash disciple: "Senior Su, why have you come? Those pursuers..."

choice.prompt: How would Chen Ji handle Su Qingyao's concern and questioning?

choices.description: Revealing to Su Qingyao the identity crisis of the Demonic Path commander and the ten-day agreement, in exchange for her trust and assistance.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his connection to the Demonic Path commander
choices.visible_reward: Significantly increasing Su Qingyao's favor and trust, unlocking prerequisite conditions for Shared Destiny buff
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might misunderstand or report to the sect

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then made a move that surprised Su Qingyao—he proactively reached out and gently grasped her wrist. That touch made Su Qingyao's whole body stiffen, while Chen Ji's voice sounded at that moment, low and sincere: "Senior Su, what follows may overturn your understanding, but you must believe me."

choices.description: Maintaining thetrash persona, using a pitiful image to extract Su Qingyao's protective instincts and intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the opportunity to build genuine trust
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining hidden identity while gaining Su Qingyao's protection

text.content: That fleeting edge in Chen Ji's mouth instantly收敛, returning to his fawning appearance. He even squeezed out a few tears, looking just like a disciple who had been scared out of his wits. Su Qingyao looked at his expression, a complex light flickering in her eyes—pity, helplessness, or some indescribable emotion.

choices.description: Without revealing the truth nor feigning, but testing Su Qingyao's stance in the approaching chaotic world through roundabout inquiries.
choices.visible_reward: Clarify Su Qingyao's factional leanings, laying the foundation for future cooperation

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao, his gaze shifting slightly, and his words carried a hint of probing: 'Senior Sister Su, if one day the Tianqing Sect stood against the entire world, what would you choose?' This question was too pointed. Su Qingyao was slightly stunned, clearly not expecting such a question from this good-for-nothing junior brother.

Night wind poured through the cracks of the ruins, carrying a bone-piercing chill. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at Su Qingyao's pale profile from the fierce battle just moments ago, while his mind was rapidly calculating. Ten days, just ten days remained. The demonic path's massive army pressing at the borders, the internal strife within the sect, and that Ling Yuan who claimed to be his twin brother of destiny... This chess game was far more complex than he had imagined. And he must lay down his own strategic formation before that moment arrives.

dialogue.content: 'No matter what the sect does, I will always...' Su Qingyao's voice was soft, yet it paused for a moment. Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji, those clear cold eyes churning with complex emotions, finally turning into a sigh. 'Forget it, what's the point of telling you this? Come, let me take you out of here first.'

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing more, merely following Su Qingyao silently. He gazed at her back, and a thought suddenly surged in his heart: What role would this woman play in his chess game? A piece to be ultimately exploited, or... A faint smile curved his lips as he temporarily suppressed this thought. The future would handle itself. For now, he only needed to focus on the task at hand. The Imperial Capital in ten days would be the battlefield where all destinies were decided. And he, Chen Ji, would undoubtedly write his own legend in that storm.
